title: Canonical coordinate Hopf algebra of an affine group scheme
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $G$ an affine group scheme over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-sc-group-scheme], with affine spectrum as in [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Write $R[G]=\Gamma(G,\mathcal O_G)$. The canonical coordinate Hopf $R$-algebra is the existing Hopf algebra structure on $R[G]$ dual to the multiplication, identity and inversion of $G$: its comultiplication, counit and antipode are respectively the pullbacks of those three maps, using the canonical affine-product tensor identification. For a field $k$ [def-weil-field], the unbundled coordinate Hopf algebra is this same structure with $R=k$; it exposes the same $k$-algebra and coalgebra structures for typeclass inference. These are the canonical structures, with no auxiliary choice and no finite-type, smoothness or connectedness condition.
